notes:
ISS2000 PC Port NC 1.0.6 - 11 November 2026

What's new since 1.0.5:
- Custom kits: every team folder now has editable PNGs for the home, away and goalkeeper kits
  (shirt and sleeves), the back numbers and the captain armband. They are created from your ROM
  the first time you start the game, follow the same layout as the ISS Editor, accept images up
  to 8x the original size and reload while the game is running. Customised files are never
  overwritten.
- Back numbers sit closer to the shirt, as on a real kit.
- The captain armband now stays on the arm during replays.
